Name: Abijah, King of Judah
Summary: Abijah, son of Rehoboam and Maachah, reigned three years in Jerusalem; he trusted the LORD against Jeroboam's far larger army and won a great victory, though he married fourteen wives.
KeyStory: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, appealed to the covenant with David, and Judah prevailed because they relied on the LORD God of their fathers.
RelatedPeople: Rehoboam; Maachah, Daughter of Absalom; Jeroboam; King Asa
LifeLesson: Victory belongs to those who rely on the LORD, not to the larger army.
